description:
As Senior Manager at URW, I work with Data Science Team, IT, Digital Products and Business teams. In this context I play several roles:
* Mall Data Quality & Analytics (team of 4)
 - Documentation of the existing and new architecture design
 - Put in place monitoring boards & data quality alerts
 - Target infra pain points and redefine data ingestion architecture
 - Reporting automation
* Loyalty & CRM Data (team of 3)
 - specifications on dashboards & task management for loyalty program insights
 - drive the future of our CRM data platform (new features and implementation)
* New revenues program manager
In this program, I lead one of 4 streams around new revenues (Data Platform) reuniting ~50 internals and ~20 externals.
 - Product Manager: define the roadmap using online/CRM and offline data
 - Data Lead: define the architecture of our platform and support the migration to GCP
 - More details: https://cloud.google.com/customers/unibail-rodamco-westfield
* Mall Data Science Team (team of 4+2)
 - specs definition for dashboards and reports
 - task management
 - data quality
 - retailer portal / metrics & data
Compétences : Management · Program Management · Gestion de produit · Leadership d’équipe transverse

I changed scope to work on the audience self-service side. My main contributions are on those topics:
 - building an internal & public API with version management to handle audiences
- building a front-end dedicated to audiences management
- migration to the new API internally and internship management on this topic
 - deprecate an old API and monitor the global advancement of the project with dedicated organization
- add a new feature on audiences combinations that required a complete data model change (migration for audience builder + decoupling segment/campaign)
- cleaning of old audiences in DB + deprecating duplicated tables across the architecture
- design + internship management for new segment: Lookalike --> 2M Revenue/y
- design & planning + implementation for new delivery type: lite setup --> 2M Revenue/y
- design & planning + database migration of a type of segment ; along with UX changes

Aside from those topics; I also worked on:
- clarifying what data-sharing means for Criteo
- acted as a main point of contact on several topics for clients and I helped solving dependencies
- worked in collaboration with Product, Project Managers and UX Designers to refine the specs of several products
- participated to several hackathons --> ex. the video events tracking project was in the shortlist for winners and led to features in prod under 3 days delivering value for the company
- shared product and tech knowledge during weekly demos
- managed an intern for 6 months
- act as a point of functional reference
- planned teams' priorities and acted as Agile facilitator for team regular updates (stand-up, retros, planning)
- hackathon: a Criteo light application in React.JS
- bonus: I planned several team buildings (eg. cooking class with a TopChef participant!)

C# | Angular | node | .net | Agile | Figma | Gerrit | Git | SQL | Hive | Hue | API design | Rest APIs | Swagger | Specs writing | Product | Demo presentations | Grafana | Kibana | CodeSearch
Compétences : .NET framework · Microservices · Kanban · Independence · Agile Environment · Back-End Web Development · TypeScript · Angular · .NET Core

At Criteo, I worked on audience-related issues. Criteo has several solutions to create audiences based on user criteria, business goals or demographics (Commerce, Prospecting, AppInstall, Algebra, Custom Audience...). Some audiences are computed real time while others are computed after a delay.

Main projects and responsabilities:
- prod cop: keep the team from being disturbed and solve production issues
- maintain audience pipelines (several ~1h to 4h pipelines processing up to ~1PB of data daily)
- tech debt: audience pipeline split
- tech debt: make audience pipeline work with another type of Id
- tech debt: make audience pipeline work with GDPR identity
- new product: specs + implementation of audience algebra to make algebras of several audiences
- new product: specs + implementation of real time size estimations (algebra, commerce, custom)
- product revamp: specs + implementation of audience manager UI
- hackathon: dashboard to monitor basic stats on data to help debug models

Compétences : Microservices · Independence · Java · Back-End Web Development · Apache Kafka · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

Nextperf is a startup that owns a Demand-Side Platform (DSP) buying advertising for brands and retailers ; optimized on performance and at the best price. My job is about building datasets as part of Data-Science team which owns the ML algorithms used by at bidding time by the DSP.
My contribution was around 3 axis:
Technical contribution
- Technical reference on the platform: DSP and global architecture, data pipelines handling ~2TB user events daily, maintaining analysts PostgreSQL tables
- Tech debt reduction: migration of Hadoop/Java pipelines to Spark/Scala, creation of a library to simplify features creation for machine learning models (Java) and creation of a library to ease new data set creation for data-scientists, and refactoring our pipelines to use this internal framework
- Migration of our Data-Engineering architecture from Amazon AWS to Google GCP, cluster interventions and scheduling management
New products
- new conversion rate algorithm from scratch (job in production with new libraries)
- other minor algorithms improvements (eg. Basket estimation / click-through rate estimate)
Data analysis
- feature engineering (new machine learning features with uplift analysis)
- buyers behaviours study to present to upper management and add new features to our models
- data anomaly detection and dashboard for data-monitoring with Domo
Hadoop | MapReduce | Spark | Scala | AWS EMR | Google DataProc | Python | Maths | Probabilities | SQL | Postgres | Redshift | BigQuery | Parquet | Json | Algorithms | Machine Learning | Java | Git | Rest APIs | Jupyter | matplotlib | Airflow
Compétences : Airflow · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Object Storage · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Microservices · PostgreSQL · Independence · Java · Apache Kafka · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)

TPC is a start-up building a platform to automate advertising programmatic purchase across platforms and with automated budget repartition. Under the direction of Joaquin Fernandez-Tapia et Christophe Bourgoin, my internship is divided in 3 steps:
1. I started by studying and simulating the theory behind real-time bidding (RTB maths)
2. I built a tool to buy ads accross platforms; saving ad-managers up to 90% of their day
3. I collected and compiled data in a database for exploitation by data-scientists and analysts.
Maths | Probabilities | Python | matplotlib | pandas | requests module | Rest API | Simulation | Java | mySQL | Git.
Compétences : Independence

I designed and gave a course of 20h about 3D maths applied to game engines to bachelor level students. We worked using Unreal Engine and Unity 3D. There was a graded project and 20h of labs along with the course.
Alongside I worked on a Unity3D plugin to analyze game composition by reflection.
Compétences : Independence

I built a VR platform for crowd simulation experiments in a CAVE. It was an amazing opportunity to work with high-tech VR tools in a state-of-the-art research team. In this experience I was able to connect school theory with research problems using new technologies and tools. I was under the management of Julien Pettré as part of MimeTIC Research Team. Very good appreciation.
CAVE technologies | MiddleVR | Unity3D | Research | Physical models | Crowd simulation | C# | Git
